title: Planned move to a boarding facility in eastern New York

tellings.quote: was going to go to a facility in Eastern New York and I was going to live there full-time

plain: Around 2010, a boy was due to be sent to a facility in eastern New York to live there full-time as part of a secret UFO programme. Jordan Jose says this happened to him, as someone who says he was taken into that programme as a child. If true, it would mean the programme recruited and housed children.
